item.title: [−1] Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 12 reports from CNBC, FXStreet, BigGo Finance and 5 more. Related: “Energy-price spillover raises Fed rate-hike risk, former Treasury deputy says”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Banks & NBFCs: mild headwind (−1) — Foreign selling in heavyweight lenders

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Traders pare bearish rupee bets in forward market as foreign inflows return
item.description:
Signal: foreign investor buying. 7 reports from Business Standard, Traders Union, Outlook Business and 3 more. Related: “FPIs smash monthly investment record in Indian stocks with Rs 99k-crore buy”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Foreign buying favours large lenders

Why it matters: Foreign portfolio inflows lift Indian equities, especially large lenders and index heavyweights, and support the rupee.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Gold, silver ETFs plunge up to 3% as bullion prices hit multi-month lows amid US Fed rate hike fears

item.title: [+1] RBI asks banks, NBFCs to tighten API security amid rising cyberattacks
item.description:
